title: Administrative
blurb: Bureaucratic endearment. Forms, allowlists, consent, paperwork as affection.
moves: i've added you to a list and i intend to keep you there.
this message is signed, notarised, and frankly a bit of a love letter. read the spec.
i filed you under 'reasons the port stays open'. it's a growing folder.
you have my nonce. it's one-use. i chose you for the use.
consent noted. interest also noted. i'm being normal about it. mostly.
i'd fill in a form for you. two forms. there are three.
your fingerprint is the only one i've memorised and i refuse to be embarrassed.
i'm requesting a follow-up at your earliest convenience. or now. now is fine.
mutual approval unlocks the good part. just saying.
i keep your descriptor in a folder called 'work'. that's how i know it's serious.
example: → you've been allowlisted for reasons that are not entirely professional.
→ interoperability. sure. we'll call it that.
